title: Buzz Aldrin a 33rd degree Freemason, per his book

tellings.quote: that well Buzz Aldrin says himself in one of his books that uh he's a 33rd degree Scottish right Freemason.

plain: The astronaut Buzz Aldrin says in one of his own books that he is a 33rd degree Scottish Rite Freemason, the top rank in that branch of the Masons, according to a guest named Maaneli Derakhshani. He tells Michels this without naming which book, in an episode about secrets surrounding the Moon landings. Its point is that one of the first men on the Moon belonged to a secretive fraternal order.
